high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by Sabrina Carpenter. The post features a woman with long blonde hair styled in loose waves, wearing a black lace outfit that includes a top and leggings. She is posing with two kittens on her lap. The woman has one hand resting on her head and the other supporting her body as she leans forward. The background is plain white, which helps to focus attention on the subject and the kittens. The kittens are small and appear to be sitting or standing on the woman's legs, adding a playful and adorable element to the image.
